method: Isolated Chromium; synthetic fixtures plus real UI interactions. Not user-study data.

History filters persist; zero results recover without deleting records
Comparison rejects different tasks, allows matching versions and discloses conditions
Actual record inspection preserves filters and exposes the original plan

Fictional samples render their scored plan; no sample changes real state
No page overflow on journal, records, examples and returning home at 320, 390, 768 and 1440px
Home and journal lead with Resume and preserve an unfinished attempt
Connection workbench is keyboard accessible, exclusive and retains drafts after refresh
Result leads with a concrete contribution, one next action and collapsible details
Earlier content cannot be mixed into a current-version comparison

Reset lives in Demo controls, retains confirmation and clears new view state
No browser exceptions or failed assets in new dashboard and workspace checks
